provenance: Notes, not a response: what Plex Web 4.163.0 (app.plex.tv, read 2026-11-10) asks the community API, summarized field by field. Plex Web sends these queries with the signed-in user's X-Plex-Token as POST {query, variables} to https://community.plex.tv/api. They tell which fields exist and which types the variables take; they do not show a successful answer, which needs an account.

friends.notes: id is the community ID that user(id:) takes. idRaw is the plex.tv account number: Plex Web puts it in /api/v2/sharings/<idRaw> and uses -1 when it is missing, so it is a number. Mynou reads id, idRaw, username and displayName.

watchlist.operation: query with variables $uuid: ID (default ""), $first: PaginationInt!, $after: String
watchlist.notes: Plex Web reads both its own watchlist (empty uuid) and a friend's (the friend's community id) through user(id:). The issue named userV2(user:); Plex Web 4.163.0 only reads userV2 as a field of activity items, never as a query root, so Mynou follows user(id:).
watchlist.mynou_reads: nodes { id key type title year } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }

item.notes: A node's key is /library/metadata/<id>, which Plex Web opens on the metadata provider. A node carries no TMDB ID, so Mynou reads each new item once with includeGuids=1 (see metadata-item.json) and keeps the answer for a day.
